request.style: English, male baritone voice, solo with gentle backing choir, acoustic guitar, soft piano, cello, warm and reverent mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
My heart stirs with a noble theme
I recite my verses for the king
My tongue is the pen of a skilled scribe
Writing out what the spirit sings

[Chorus]
You are the fairest of men
Grace is poured upon your lips
Therefore God has blessed you forever
Your beauty outshines all others

[Verse]
Strap your sword to your side
O mighty one in glory and majesty
Ride out in triumph for truth
Let righteousness guide your destiny

[Chorus]
You are the fairest of men
Grace is poured upon your lips
Therefore God has blessed you forever
Your beauty outshines all others

[Bridge]
Let your right hand reveal awesome deeds
In the cause of truth and humility
Your majesty rides out in victory
A skilled scribe’s pen for the king

[Chorus]
You are the fairest of men
Grace is poured upon your lips
Therefore God has blessed you forever
Your beauty outshines all others

[Outro]
Grace is poured upon your lips
Blessed you forever
